pokedexEntries.di: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

pokedexEntries.prl: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

pokedexEntries.pt: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

pokedexEntries.shp: It undertakes photosynthesis within its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if the Pokémon is thirsty.

pokedexEntries.la: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

pokedexEntries.sc: The shell on its back is made of soil. If the shell is moist to the touch, Turtwig is very healthy.

pokedexEntries.vi: It uses its whole body to photosynthesize when exposed to sunlight. Its shell is made from hardened soil.
